name: HR 1. Department compensation and performance
rawText:
# Build a professional, developer-oriented text/code editor for OQuery.
# The editing experience should be comparable to a modern IDE editor such
# as VS Code, while providing OQuery-specific language intelligence.
# 
# The editor must support:
# 
# -   Reliable text editing and selection.
# -   Standard keyboard shortcuts.
# -   Find and replace.
# -   Multi-line and multi-cursor editing.
# -   Code-editor usability features.
# -   OQuery syntax highlighting, completion, validation, and formatting
#     integration.
# -   Automated tests for editing behavior, shortcuts, language services,
#     and regressions.
# 
# The implementation must modify the actual application, not merely
# produce a mockup or a list of recommendations.
# ____________________________________________________________

# Option 1: Multiple contexts.
ReviewSummary is PerformanceReviews: EmployeeId EmployeeId, 
    AVG(Rating) AverageRating, 
    SUM(BonusAmount) Bonuses
  Where ReviewYear = <2025>
  
Employees: Department.Name Department,
    COUNT(Id) TotalEmployees,
    AVG(Salary) AverageSalary,
    SUM(Salary) AnnualPayroll,
    AVG(ReviewSummary.AverageRating) AverageRating,
    SUM(Coalesce(ReviewSummary.Bonuses, <0>)) TotalBonuses
  Left Join ReviewSummary ReviewSummary On Id = ReviewSummary.EmployeeId
  Order AnnualPayroll ASC

# Option 2: Fluent syntax
Departments:
    Name
    Employees.Count(Id) TotalEmployees
    Employees.Avg(Salary) AverageSalary
    Employees.Sum(Salary) AnnualPayroll
    Employees.Avg(PerformanceReviews.AvgIf(Rating, ReviewYear = 2025)) AverageRating
    Employees.Sum(PerformanceReviews.SumIf(BonusAmount, ReviewYear = 2025)) TotalBonuses
 Order AnnualPayroll ASC
